$comment: Lasting decisions for scripts/sync-loc-teleports.cjs (docs/loc-teleports.md): captured loc teleports to leave out, by tile (one placement of a name many locs share), exact gameval name or pattern, with the reason; and `requirements`, the gates live OSRS refused some players at, with the requirement (Wiki) and the captured refusal; and `dialogues`, locs whose option asks first, with the question and options as the game sends them (chatbox_multi_init in the recordings): `go` are the options that lead to the captured destination, `ladder` hands an uncaptured direction to Ladders, and `answer` has the ticks from the answer (the captured ticks count from arriving, and include reading the question). A requirement or dialogue without a tile applies to every placement of that name. `include` takes locs of other kinds that are a plain move (exits, lifts, wells), by name, with the reason.
